== Summary ==
[[James Martin]] (forum Solidsnack3) takes a selfie at his computer during a GEMP game in the [[2021 Boonta Eve Jawa Brawl]], 18 June 2021, after [[Chris Kelly]] converted Luke Skywalker, The Emperor's Prize against him.

* '''Event:''' [[2021 Boonta Eve Jawa Brawl]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2021-06-18
* '''Camera date:''' 2021-06-18
* '''Photographer:''' [[James Martin]]
* '''Identification:''' the poster, Solidsnack3, posts it as his selfie.

== Source ==
Posted on the Players Committee forum: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1345268#p1345268 Achievements!], post 1345268, by Solidsnack3, 2021-06-18. Original attachment name: IMG_20210618_175034549.jpg (2304×1728); forum attachment id 14114.
* '''Posted by:''' Solidsnack3
